change_summary: Payroll moves from monthly to twice-monthly, with self-service payslips.

messages.text: Payroll moves to twice-monthly pay from 1 October.
All 2,400 staff across UK and Ireland are affected.
Colleagues asked for it in the last two engagement surveys.
Activate your portal account by 14 September 2026.
Check your bank details in the new portal, takes ten minutes.
Questions go to payroll support, 8am-6pm weekdays.
Managers complete 45 minutes of timesheet-approval training.
